reviews.title: Be careful with subscription.
reviews.text:
So on October 1, 2025 I was curious about the app and paid $18.99 for a trial period. The company let me know when I contacted them today that I would’ve received a confirmation email and I would’ve received emails letting me know that my subscription would be renewed. I received none of these. They must’ve went in my junk or spam folder.

I would never have renewed the subscription and I didn’t realize that going through Apple you wouldn’t see the subscription on your Apple subscriptions. It was my mistake for not paying attention to my credit card bill but after looking at it on October 1, 2025, I decided that the app just wasn’t for me.


I belong to a gym with a personal trainer that they provide for free. The company will refund me $69.99 from this latest transaction which is the cost of 12 weeks. So if I subtract that basically I lost $209.97 for an app I never used. So be very careful with the subscription and make sure that you check your junk or spam folder to watch for the confirmations. Don’t make my same mistake.

I should have paid more attention to my credit card bill. So just a lesson learned here. Make sure you check your credit card bill all the time since this was not through Apple subscriptions. It never showed up and I never got a notification from Apple telling me a renewal was done.
